charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested checking nightstand_b1 for almost all queries, but on day 11 it was at desk_o1 at both 09:34 and 16:03. The charger is at desk_o1 during Tomas's work hours (09:00-17:00). Check desk_o1 for daytime queries and nightstand_b1 only for late evening/night (18:00+).

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested checking desk_o1 for mid-day (10:00-16:00) and dish_rack_k1 for late night, but at 19:43 it was at dining_table_d1. The bottle is at dining_table_d1 during early evening (18:00-21:00). Check dining_table_d1 for early evening, desk_o1 for mid-day, and dish_rack_k1 for very late night (22:00+).

mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested checking cupboard_k1 for late night (22:00+), but at 22:00 it was at coffee_table_l1. The "late night" window for cupboard_k1 starts later than 22:00. Check coffee_table_l1 for early late-night (21:00-22:30) and cupboard_k1 only for very late night (23:00+).

glass_tomas: Previous notes suggested checking dining_table_d1 for early evening (19:00-21:30) and nightstand_b1 for very late night (22:00+). No new errors today; keep this pattern.
